name: Pizzeria Santa Lucia
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Santa Lucia in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Santa Lucia** in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Our cozy restaurant invites you to savor delicious **Pizza Napoletana**, fresh pasta, and classic Italian dishes in a warm, rustic atmosphere.

Indulge in our signature **Kaiserschmarrn** for breakfast or enjoy a glass of fine **Tiroler Wein** with your meal. Whether you're exploring **Innsbruck**, skiing in the **Zillertal**, or simply taking a break on your journey through **Tirol**, **Pizzeria Santa Lucia** is the perfect spot for a taste of Italy in the mountains.

Come and experience our warm hospitality—we look forward to welcoming you!
